d:
Want to lose weight without counting calories, tracking macros, or weighing every bite of food? You can. In this video, I’m showing you a simple, visual way to eat for fat loss using the food already on your plate. No calorie-counting app, complicated diet rules, or endless food math required.
I’m Jeff Cavaliere, physical therapist and strength coach, and I want to show you the plate method I still use myself. If you’re wondering how to lose weight without counting calories, you can try it at your very next meal.
